authors.affiliation: Lockheed Martin Integrated Systems and Solutions
authors.bio: William A. Hill is a senior engineer at Lockheed Martin Integrated Systems and Solutions, with experience in CCD design and device physics dating back to 1970. He has developed the CCD and its support electronics for the Lockheed Martin 4K-24P camera project. Hill has a BS and MS in physics from California State University at Los Angeles.
authors.name: William A. Hill

authors.affiliation: Lockheed Martin Integrated Systems and Solutions in San Jose, CA.
authors.bio: Steve N. Persall is a senior graphic artist/photographer at Lockheed Martin Integrated Systems and Solutions in San Jose, CA., with 25 years of experience in graphics, multimedia production, image processing, and workflow management. He has worked on system storage and network architectures, color management, and post-production for the Lockheed Martin 4K-24P camera.
authors.name: Steve Persall

authors.affiliation: Signals Information Systems division of Lockheed Martin
authors.bio: Robert W. McGriff is the chief engineer for the Signals Information Systems division of Lockheed Martin. He has various signal processing, RF, and optical systems design experience going back to 1985. McGriff has a MS degree in nuclear engineering from Kansas State University.
authors.name: Robert McGriff
